mapper.sql: FROM crm_email_record email JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.customer_id = email.customer_id AND customer.tenant_id = email.tenant_id AND customer.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity opportunity ON email.biz_type = 'OPPORTUNITY' AND opportunity.opportunity_id = email.biz_id AND opportunity.tenant_id = email.tenant_id AND opportunity.customer_id = email.customer_id AND opportunity.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_quote quote ON email.biz_type = 'QUOTE' AND quote.quote_id = email.biz_id AND quote.tenant_id = email.tenant_id AND quote.customer_id = email.customer_id AND quote.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_service_ticket ticket ON email.biz_type = 'TICKET' AND ticket.ticket_id = email.biz_id AND ticket.tenant_id = email.tenant_id AND ticket.customer_id = email.customer_id AND ticket.deleted = 0

((email.biz_type = 'CUSTOMER' AND email.biz_id = email.customer_id) OR (email.biz_type = 'OPPORTUNITY' AND opportunity.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL) OR (email.biz_type = 'QUOTE' AND quote.quote_id IS NOT NULL) OR (email.biz_type = 'TICKET' AND ticket.ticket_id IS NOT NULL))
mapper.select:
SELECT email.*, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id
WHERE email.email_id = #{emailId} AND
SELECT * FROM crm_email_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email_id = #{emailId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM crm_email_record WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation_key = #{operationKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISTINCT menu.perms FROM sys_user account JOIN sys_tenant tenant_entry ON tenant_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND tenant_entry.deleted = 0 AND tenant_entry.status = '0' JOIN sys_user_role membership ON membership.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND membership.user_id = account.user_id JOIN sys_role role_entry ON role_entry.role_id = membership.role_id AND role_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND role_entry.deleted = 0 AND role_entry.status = '0' JOIN sys_role_menu grant_entry ON grant_entry.tenant_id = account.tenant_id AND grant_entry.role_id = role_entry.role_id JOIN sys_menu menu ON menu.menu_id = grant_entry.menu_id AND menu.status = '0' WHERE account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND (tenant_entry.expire_time IS NULL OR tenant_entry.expire_time > NOW()) AND menu.perms IS NOT NULL AND menu.perms != ''
SELECT user_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = '0' AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_email_record SET read_flag = 1, read_time = NOW(), update_by = 'email-observation', update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND email_id = #{emailId} AND direction = 'OUTBOUND' AND read_flag = 0 AND send_status IN ('QUEUED', 'SENDING', 'SENT', 'UNKNOWN')
